description: Unit tests for SpdyProxyClientSocket, testing connection, reading, writing, error handling, and logging behaviors in a SPDY/HTTP2 proxy context.

classes.name: SpdyProxyClientSocketTest
classes.description: Test fixture for testing SpdyProxyClientSocket behaviors including connection, data transfer, error handling, and logging.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up mock socket data, SSL info, and creates a SPDY session and stream for testing.

methods.name: AssertConnectSucceeds
methods.description: Asserts that the socket connection completes successfully.

methods.name: AssertConnectFails
methods.description: Asserts that the connection attempt fails with the specified error.

methods.name: AssertConnectionEstablished
methods.description: Verifies that the connection response indicates success and SSL info is as expected.

methods.name: AssertSyncReadEquals
methods.description: Performs a synchronous read and verifies the data matches expected.

methods.name: AssertSyncReadEOF
methods.description: Verifies that a synchronous read returns EOF (0 bytes).

methods.name: AssertAsyncReadEquals
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous read and verifies the data matches expected.

methods.name: AssertReadStarts
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous read, expecting it to be pending.

methods.name: AssertReadReturns
methods.description: Completes a pending read and verifies the data matches expected.

methods.name: AssertAsyncWriteSucceeds
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous write and expects it to succeed.

methods.name: AssertWriteReturns
methods.description: Performs a write and verifies the return value matches expected.

methods.name: AssertWriteLength
methods.description: Verifies that the write completed with the expected number of bytes.

methods.name: AddAuthToCache
methods.description: Adds proxy authentication credentials to the auth cache.

methods.name: ResumeAndRun
methods.description: Resumes paused socket data and runs the event loop.

methods.name: CloseSpdySession
methods.description: Closes the SPDY session with an error.
